notes: Elbow locked, palm facing your thigh: swing the straight arm forward and back like a pendulum, 3 times, fast. Same plane as a curl, no sideways motion.
Alternate arms; count only the sensor arm's lifts. Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lift 6: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. All other lifts: full and strict.
Slow: 3 s up, 3 s down. Count out loud: 7 lifts. All full and strict.
Count out loud: 7 lifts. Lift 4: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. All other lifts: full and strict.
Shake out your arm and fiddle with the strap for about 15 s, without moving the band. Not a set.
Walk around for about 15 s, arms natural. Not a set: the counter should say 0.
Count out loud: 6 lifts. Lifts 2, 3 and 5: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lifts 2 and 3: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 4 and 5: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Fast: as fast as you can while staying in control. Count out loud: 10 lifts. All full and strict.
Count out loud: 13 lifts. Lift 2: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. Lift 12: hold 2–3 s halfway up, then finish it. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 9 lifts. Lifts 2, 5 and 6: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lifts 5 and 8: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 3 and 9: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Put the dumbbell down and pick it up again, three times. Not a set.
Curl until you can't do one more full rep. Count full reps only and TYPE that count at the prompt (Enter would record 0).
Same pendulum swings: elbow locked, palm facing your thigh, forward and back only.
